audit.text:
Instagram Bio Audit Checklist and Better Title Patterns for @favisionent

Profile Audit Checklist:
1. Is the brand name clear? Check that F.A Vision Enterprise or a recognizable variation is present.
2. Is the location clear? Check that Odorkor, Accra, Ghana or showroom directions are mentioned.
3. Are the core products clear? Check that quality furniture like sofas, beds, dining sets, wardrobes, office furniture, and student desks are highlighted.
4. Is the tagline included? Check for: More comfort. More style.
5. Is the main contact method present? Check that the WhatsApp number 020 747 3267 is listed.
6. Is the website link working and included? Check that https://favisionenterprize.github.io/ is in the bio link section.
7. Does the bio stay within the 150-character limit? Ensure brevity and clarity.
8. Do post titles and thumbnail covers instantly show what we sell, such as our sofas, beds, or dining sets?
9. Do reel and post covers feature clean photography of our showroom items on Tarazzo Road, opposite Pacific, Odorkor?
10. Are prices and direct actions included where relevant in post captions?

5 Better Title Patterns for This Brand:
1. Upgrade Your Space: [Product Name] at F.A Vision Enterprise in Odorkor, Accra
2. More Comfort, More Style: Discover Our [Product Name] Today
3. Visit Our Showroom: See the [Product Name] Live on Tarazzo Road, Odorkor
4. Quality Furniture in Accra: The [Product Name] You Need
5. Shop Smart with F.A Vision Enterprise: Check Out Our [Product Name]
